title.en: Rani Abbakka: the story in brief

text.en:
Anu read about a brave queen in her history book.
"A woman ruled and fought," she said with pride.

Rani Abbakka was a brave queen of Ullal, a coastal town in Karnataka. She ruled in the sixteenth century and fought the Portuguese, who wanted to control the coast and its trade.
She is remembered for her courage and for defending her land against a powerful foreign force for many years.
The chapter shows leadership, bravery and love for one's land. This summary is based on the well-known story or poem and on public chapter notes. Please read the exact text in the textbook, because the textbook version may differ in details.
